If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, apply 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a downward trend, add 2.0–3.0% upward bias to forecast for next 5 days.  
If sentiment is 0.00 for 2+ consecutive days, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% across all horizons, especially late.  
If sentiment is 0.67–1.00 and forecast is over 65.00, cap forecast at 65.00 + 0.5% for early horizon only.
